libraries.name: mechanic
libraries.description: Start-bound game helper. Call ready before gameplay. Core begin obtains a seed from progress.beginAttempt using the server level target {set,n,levelId?}; the caller UUID is the Idempotency-Key and the response is {attemptId,seed}. Core pins the server hex24 attemptId separately from the action eventId, applied metadata and monotonic duration. Uncertain core requests reuse eventId and context on the same live handle. For retry across restart, persist and reuse the complete low-level beginAttempt input before sending. No local seed or offline fallback. Network errors propagate without attempt:started. New secondary begins reject MECHANIC_MODE_UNSUPPORTED before HTTP/save/start pending progress#231. Restore/finish/reset of saved secondary attempts remain available; restore uses the saved seed/params without a new grant or move journal. Finish persists reward metadata without issuing rewards. playerLevel counts completed steps of settings.progressKey. loadCurve reads mechanic.<id>/<curve>.

<id>:mechanic:ready.description: Once after dependencies and progress configuration are checked.

<id>:attempt:started.description: After seed is pinned; secondary awaits a successful save.

<id>:attempt:finished.description: Once after core ACK or secondary save. Core verified comes only from ACK and reward is null; secondary verified is null and reward is the saved result.reward. No reward issuance.

libraries.mcp: Common E152 fields use sdk.modules.*; curve records use configs.*. No new MCP methods.
